newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Nov 27.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Henri Konan Bedie, after talks with President Jacques Chirac in France, backs despatch of international force to protect humanitarian aid in Zaire; says Ivorian Foreign Minister Amara Essy quite capable of doing job of U.N. secretary general but says problem of Boutros Boutros-Ghali's second term will be dealt with at Organisation of African Unity level.
- Ivory Coast's programme to tarmac roads advances -- 25.4 km of metalled road added between Bondoukou and Bouna in the north east over past 10 months

- This opposition Ivorian Popular Front newspaper publishes letter from group of army officers, who ask to remain anonymous and say that confessions from soldiers relating to an alleged coup attempt surrounding the turbulent 1995 presidential election were extracted under torture; officers call for public trials of all accused who appeared before a secret military tribunal

- New shipping line to operate feeder service out of Abidjan port acting as a link between Europe and West Africa; service will be operated by Seaways Africa, a subsidiary of German shipping company Deco-Line
